description: Henrico, VA – Today marks six months since the start of the cost-spiking war with Iran. Wittman continues to back the war despite the fact that it has resulted in the death of American servicemembers, has cost our country billions of dollars, and Virginians are forced to pay more at the gas pump and the grocery store.

title: SIX MONTHS IN: Rob Wittman Has Voted Five Times to Continue A War in Iran That's Raising Costs on Virginia Families - Shannon Taylor for Virginia
